payload.title: Bind reinvented /newsroom to live pilobol-us GraphQL (not demo fixtures)
payload.description:
Demo fixtures = offline chrome only. Live path:

1. Real amplify_outputs.json (sandbox first, then prod) — not demo stub
2. PAPYRUS_GRAPHQL_JWT + endpoint matching outputs
3. Fix corpora/pilobol-us-steering.yml s3Prefix to real bucket from amplify_outputs (not s3://pilobol-us-demo/...)
4. Materialize/sync corpus: copy or link Pilobol.us corpora/pilobol-us into Papyrus worker tree OR sync-from Pilobol accession
5. papyrus ops corpora sync-to-cloud --corpus-key pilobol-us
6. references prepare-catalog + create-from-catalog (pending) from catalog.json
7. Run /newsroom without ?demo=1 with PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND=pilobol-us — References shows real keepers

Needs from Ryan/Pilobol: AWS profile or real sandbox/prod amplify_outputs + JWT mint path (PAPYRUS_JWT_SECRET / auth refresh-jwt).
